subject: MAP kickoff — internal scenario walkthrough and RACI check
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — internal scenario walkthrough and RACI check

Team,

We have the MAP kickoff with AvaTech scheduled for next Tuesday (Dec 7). Before we go live with the customer, I want a focused internal dry-run to walk through the mutual action plan, confirm owners, and run a short evaluation scenario so we know who owns each decision point.

Objective: make sure RACI is clear and our evaluation plan covers the customer’s success criteria + performance checks.

Asks before EOD today (Nov 30):
- Review the attached MAP_v0.9.xlsx and call out any missing milestones or owners.
- Validate the eval plan (EvaluationPlan_v1.md) for who will run the latency/accuracy checks and produce the final pass/fail criteria.
- Confirm availability for a 45-min internal dry-run on Dec 3 at 10:00 PST. If unavailable, list alternatives.

Quick notes from my review:
- Proposed RACI in tab "Owners" has Sales (Vivek) — Account lead; SE (Lauren) — Technical eval lead; Engineering (Marcus) — performance & rollout; CS (Monica) — adoption & success criteria.
- Decision gate: go/no-go on pilot based on evaluation pass on latency (p90 < 200ms) and quality (n=50 prompt eval, accept rate > 92%).

Attachments: MAP_v0.9.xlsx, EvaluationPlan_v1.md, prekick-agenda.pdf (agenda draft is short).

I’m leaving the high-level agenda below — please annotate and send back edits. If anyone thinks we need procurement or legal pre-reads, flag now and I’ll add them to the attendee list.

Pre-kick dry-run agenda (45 mins):
1) 5m — Goals, timeline, and success criteria (Vivek)
2) 10m — Walkthrough MAP milestones and owner confirmations (Lauren + Vivek)
3) 15m — Evaluation plan: who runs what, datasets, pass thresholds (Marcus)
4) 10m — Risks, fallback plan, and communication cadence (Monica)
5) 5m — Final actions / confirm next steps

Thanks — please reply with: ACK / comments / availability.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — internal scenario walkthrough and RACI check

ACK and quick comments inline.

- MAP_v0.9: I added a "Technical prerequisites" row under Milestone 2 (network, KMS scope, model variant). Please ensure we own the region mapping for their data residency ask.
- EvaluationPlan_v1: suggest adding an acceptance owner for the qualitative review (I propose Monica as the business acceptance owner; Marcus remains technical).
- Agenda: add a 5m slot to validate the customer test dataset (we need to confirm sample prompts from Sara).

Availability: Dec 3 at 10:00 PST works for me.

One open item: procurement may ask for a timeline on contract signatures before pilot start. If we want procurement involved in the kickoff, we should invite them to the customer meeting or run a separate procurement sync. Thoughts?

-- Lauren
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Quick nod from eng side — I skimmed the MAP and eval plan. A few technical items I will own and bring to the dry-run:
- Performance harness owner: Marcus Lin (I will run p95/p99, memory, and KV cache behavior tests).
- Quantization/variant: I’ll prepare two runbooks: 1) fp16 baseline; 2) int8 quantized (if their perf targets require it).
- Dependency: need a small test corpus from Sara (10–20 representative prompts) to reproduce expected distribution — Lauren, can you chase that in the customer prep?

I’ll also draft a short test script to exercise streaming throughput and attach results after the Dec 3 dry-run.

Availability: Dec 3 at 10:00 PST OK. If we go earlier, I can still make it but prefer 10a.

Thanks — Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — good alignment.

Updates based on feedback:
- Monica assigned as business acceptance owner (EvaluationPlan_v1, section 2).
- Marcus assigned performance harness and quantization runbooks (per his note).
- Lauren to request the 10–20 sample prompts from Sara (AvaTech) and confirm region/data residency ask.

Please review the attached updated MAP and, if you have no edits, reply with a single-line ACK. Once I have ACKs, I’ll schedule the dry-run for Dec 3 10:00 PST and send calendar invites.
